run_experiment_training: run the PCQM4M-LSC Jaxline experiment in train mode using platform.main with the Experiment class
run_experiment_evaluation: run the experiment evaluate method to generate predictions on a dataset split and compute MAE and MSE metrics
build_ema_update: build an exponential moving average parameter update using tf1_ema with decay warmup for model parameters
restore_checkpoint: restore experiment state from a checkpoint.dill file using _restore_state_to_in_memory_checkpointer
save_checkpoint: save experiment state including params and opt_state to a checkpoint.dill file using _save_state_from_in_memory_checkpointer
